findings.title: Preserve ErrNotFound when adding the user ID.
findings.rationale:
Lookup documents and exports ErrNotFound for missing users. Wrap it with %w so callers can use errors.Is(err, ErrNotFound) while retaining the user ID.

Proposed fix

-		return "", fmt.Errorf("user %q: no such user", id) +		return "", fmt.Errorf("user %q: %w", id, ErrNotFound)
